nyx-ask.speaker: nyx
nyx-ask.text: Flutter flutter! I'm Nyx. My three favorite star pictures have gone dark. Will you draw them in the sky with me?

nyx-hint.speaker: narrator
nyx-hint.text: Press down at a star sign to see a shape. Then fly to the stars and touch them in order.

nyx-progress.speaker: nyx
nyx-progress.text: Oh, it's glowing again! Keep drawing!

nyx-thanks.speaker: nyx
nyx-thanks.text: My star pictures! The night is beautiful again. Let me share my moon magic with you.

power-moon.speaker: narrator
power-moon.text: Nyx taught you Moon Phase! Press down at a moon dial to change night into day, or day into night. Sun walls fade at night, and shadow walls fade in the day.

selene-ask.speaker: selene
selene-ask.text: Hello, dear. I'm Selene. My four moon feathers drifted across Mirror Lake, past the sun walls and shadow walls. Will you bring them to me?

selene-hint.speaker: narrator
selene-hint.text: When a wall is in the way, look at it. Is it a sun wall or a shadow wall? Then use a moon dial to choose day or night!

selene-progress.speaker: selene
selene-progress.text: How lovely! There are more across the lake.

selene-thanks.speaker: selene
selene-thanks.text: All four feathers! You think so carefully. Thank you, dear.

hoot-ask.speaker: hoot
hoot-ask.text: Hoo hoo! I'm Professor Hoot, Owl's cousin. My three favorite books are locked behind the lantern doors. Each door has a clue. Can you solve them?

hoot-hint.speaker: narrator
hoot-hint.text: Listen to each clue. Press down at a lantern to light it, or to blow it out.

hoot-progress.speaker: hoot
hoot-progress.text: Splendid! Another book. Keep reading those clues!

hoot-thanks.speaker: hoot
hoot-thanks.text: My books! You are a true clue solver. Hoo hoo!

library-clue-1.speaker: narrator
library-clue-1.text: Light the yellow lantern and the green lantern.

library-clue-2.speaker: narrator
library-clue-2.text: Light the red lantern and the one next to it, but not the blue one.

library-clue-3.speaker: narrator
library-clue-3.text: Light every lantern except the purple one and the one right after it.

mochi-ask.speaker: mochi
mochi-ask.text: Mrrow! I'm Mochi, the palace cat. I scattered my four moonstones all over the palace. You'll need every trick you know!

mochi-hint.speaker: narrator
mochi-hint.text: Day and night, lanterns, shrinking and fizzing. You know them all. Plan your way!

mochi-progress.speaker: mochi
mochi-progress.text: Purr! A moonstone! Keep going, you can find them all!

mochi-thanks.speaker: mochi
mochi-thanks.text: All four moonstones! The palace shines again. Purrr!

palace-clue.speaker: narrator
palace-clue.text: Light two lanterns: the one right after the purple lantern, and the one right before the green lantern.

moonbeam-note-1.speaker: nova
moonbeam-note-1.text: Hello, sweet alicorn. We are Pip's mama and papa. We fell asleep in the Moonbeam Kingdom, and our light became four moon shards. From, Mama and Papa.

moonbeam-note-2.speaker: nova
moonbeam-note-2.text: One of our shards rests by Mirror Lake. Day and night will help you find the way. From, Mama and Papa.

moonbeam-note-3.speaker: nova
moonbeam-note-3.text: Professor Hoot's library hides a shard. Read every clue carefully! From, Mama and Papa.

moonbeam-note-4.speaker: nova
moonbeam-note-4.text: Our last shard is deep in the Moon Palace. Bring all four to the observatory, and we can go home to Pip. From, Mama and Papa.

moonbeam-altar-0.speaker: narrator
moonbeam-altar-0.text: The moon altar is waiting for four moon shards.

moonbeam-altar-1.speaker: narrator
moonbeam-altar-1.text: One shard is home. Three more to find!

moonbeam-altar-2.speaker: narrator
moonbeam-altar-2.text: Two shards are home. Two more to find!

moonbeam-altar-3.speaker: narrator
moonbeam-altar-3.text: Three shards are home. Just one more!

moonbeam-altar-finale.speaker: narrator
moonbeam-altar-finale.text: Mama Nova and Papa Orion shine again! Now Pip's whole family can go home. Go and see Pip!

moonbeam-altar-done.speaker: narrator
moonbeam-altar-done.text: Mama and Papa twinkle over the observatory.

pip-parents.speaker: pip
pip-parents.text: Sol is home too! There's just one more thing. My mama and papa are lost in the Moonbeam Kingdom. Will you find them?

pip-family-home.speaker: pip
pip-family-home.text: Mama! Papa! Luma! Sol! We're all together again! Thank you, my best friend. You brought my whole family home!

family-home.speaker: narrator
family-home.text: The whole star family is home! Pip's family will shine over your glade forever.

hoot-favor-ask.speaker: hoot
hoot-favor-ask.text: Would you like to hear a story? First, answer my question!

nyx-favor-ask.speaker: nyx
nyx-favor-ask.text: I'd love to read Professor Hoot's books at night, but it's so dark. He has a moon lantern!

hoot-lantern-ask.speaker: hoot
hoot-lantern-ask.text: My moon lantern? Of course! Just solve my puzzle first.

hoot-lantern-give.speaker: hoot
hoot-lantern-give.text: Here is my moon lantern. Take it to Nyx!

nyx-favor-wait.speaker: nyx
nyx-favor-wait.text: Do you have the moon lantern yet?

nyx-favor-thanks.speaker: nyx
nyx-favor-thanks.text: The moon lantern! Now I can read all night long. Thank you!
